title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E3 — Here Comes The Bride There Goes The Bride
Fred's protest against Lamont's impending marriage fails to change his son's mind. But as the ceremony begins, the bride-to-be changes her mind, leaving Lamont standing at the altar and haggling with his relatives over their wedding gifts.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E4 — The Copper Caper
Fred's suspicions about a used-copper salesman are ignored by Lamont, especially after his son checks the metal's going price. But unfortunately for everyone, Fred's instincts prove to be correct. The copper Lamont bought was stolen.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E5 — A Matter Of Life And Breath
Lamont and Fred, at Lamont's insistence, take advantage of the free tests offered by a Breathmobile. The results convince Fred that he has tuberculosis.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E6 — We Were Robbed
Fred covers his clumsiness by proclaiming 'we were robbed' and he turns into a boastful hero cited for bravery. But Lamont finds the shattered remains of his prized porcelain and glass collection and decides to teach his father a lesson.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E1 — Grand Opening, The-part 1
George's boasting of how well he is doing heads him for a disaster when the underworld gets into the act, in Part I of a two-part story.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E3 — Once A Friend
George is seeing an old navy buddy, but is it a man or a woman? Louise is suspicious and George is confused.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E4 — George's Help
George jumps at the chance of getting a street kid to work for him at half price, but finds it's costing him more than he bargained for.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E5 — George's Legacy
If Napoleon and Lincoln could do it, so can George Jefferson -- at least that's what George believes.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E6 — Good News, Bad News
An introduction to a friend puts Helen and Louise's friendship on the line -- and George couldn't be happier.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E7 — The Visitors
George and Louise are caught in the line of fire when Florence's battling parents pay the Jefferson household an unexpected and unnerving visit.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E8 — Camp-out, The
George may be over his head when he introduces his young clerk Marcus to 'roughing it.'.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S3 E17 — Marty Feldman, Howard Cosell, Sandy Duncan
Marty Feldman battles the Beast In The Basket and Howard Cosell judges Sandy & Flip's cakes in the county fair bake-off.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S3 E19 — Phyllis Diller, The Committee
Flip seeks a loan; Phyllis does her classic stand-up and comedy troupe The Committee do hilarious sketches.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S3 E20 — The Amazing Kreskin, Diana Sands, Dom DeLuise
Kreskin performs magic and acts in a sketch w/Flip & Diana Sands; Dom DeLuise battles Geraldine in the grocery store.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S3 E21 — Della Reese, George Carlin, Roy Clark
Carlin & Flip report the news; Carlin does a monologue on race & society and the cast does a comic courtroom scene.

title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E4 — James Baldwin - Part 1
Author James Baldwin is interviewed by the young Black poetess Nikki Giovanni in a special two-part presentation of Soul!, taped in London.

title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E5 — James Baldwin - Part 2
The second installment in a special, two-part program featuring James Baldwin.

title: Webster
description:

A convicted gambler undergoing rehab has a profound influence on Webster.

title: Webster
description:
S6 E13 — Bowled Over
Katherine joins a bowling league hoping to persuade the sponsors to help with one of her programs, unaware they are such horrible people.

title: Webster
description:

Webster gets a brand new bike, but ends up getting a ticket from a cop.

title: Webster
description:
S6 E15 — The Science Project
When Frieda gets sick and can't make it to the science fair, Webster has to come to the rescue.

title: Webster
description:
S6 E16 — The Gospel Truth
Webster inadvertently books a gospel group instead of a rock band for a school party.

title: Sister, Sister
description:

While the twins go in search of a Halloween rave, Lisa and Ray attend a fancy party thrown by a prospective client.

title: Sister, Sister
description:

Tia and Tamera think they're in for a "free ride" when Ray starts dating their science teacher.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S3 E9 — Thanksgiving in Hawaii (Part I)
When Ray and Lisa take the girls to Hawaii for Thanksgiving, they're forced to share their condo with their "exes," who have begun dating each other.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S3 E10 — Thanksgiving in Hawaii (Part II)
While Ray and Lisa frantically search for the twins, who are missing in Hawaii, Roger opens the Campbell/Landry home to hobos for Thanksgiving dinner.

title: Sister, Sister
description:

The prospect of Tia's attending a prestigious prep school puts social pressure on Tia and financial pressure on Lisa.

Dorian pulls an illegal scam involving Frank’s credit card and makes matters worse by lying about it, behavior that could have dramatic consequences.
